ProjectionNotes: Replays the fresh repeated eleven-case native matrix runs[2]; earlier seven-case run independently corroborates successful cases. Sequence is one-based within runs[2].events.
Initial PENDING and bounded missing replicas precede explicit scheduler drain; first terminal source HEAD drains all due local work. Native wall-clock latency is not an AWS SLA.

Native owner account, bucket/role names and opaque version IDs are rebound. Actual binary uploads, SHA256 checksums, readable replica bytes, source/replica version and LastModified equality remain asserted.
Pending jobs and IAM/configuration survive SQLite reconstruction before drain. Committed replica bytes and status survive another reopen before the first successful GET.

GetObjectVersion and GetObjectVersionForReplication are independent permitted alternatives for these SSE-S3 objects. Explicit denial of one does not deny the separately allowed other. Dual denial or denial of the only grant fails.

Calls.At is a local scheduler projection, not native wall-clock latency: start at the first call timestamp truncated to milliseconds, freeze time between Drain rows, and on each Drain advance to max(the original row.At truncated to milliseconds, previous local time plus one second). Larger native drain jumps are retained. Drain catches up all due work synchronously; automatic workers remain enabled. Original timestamps remain unchanged in the native evidence bundles.
Limitations: SSE-S3 only; no KMS fallback claim. No CloudTrail fixture in this slice.
Native setup run0 BadDigest resulted from an incorrect CLI body transport and is excluded from the alias contract; its cleanup remains in raw evidence.
ExcludedObservations: Repeated pending polls, setup/readback plumbing, and native teardown remain in raw evidence but are not replayed.
IntegrationNotes: All five replication groups use TestS3ReplicationNativeReplay and the existing runS3ObjectCalls on memory and SQLite. The draft partition-binding gap is resolved by the shared replay values map; original drafting limitations remain as provenance.

Source paths resolve beneath testdata/aws. Complete native captures retain original inputs, HTTP results, raw XML, polling and cleanup. Historical paths inside evidence are capture provenance, never runtime dependencies. Supplemental recovered binary files and digest evidence are packaged in s3/replication_payload_evidence.json.gz.

Native capture packaging removes credential-bearing fields, including non-secret audit access-key identifiers. No permission inputs, response outcomes, payload bytes, versions or audit principal/session ARNs are changed. Scheduling/drain/reopen are local projections, not native latency guarantees.
